theater: 常州城與江南運河下游

battle.name: 常州之戰
battle.theater: 常州城與江南運河下游
battle.brief: 至元十二年（1275）十月，伯顏統元軍抵鎮江，隨即進攻扼住江南運河水道的常州城；宋軍據城死守，屢挫元軍攻城器械，至十一月城破，守軍全滅。城頭密集佈防的弩手是宋軍唯一能越過女牆壓制進攻者的手段，機械張弦換來射程與穿透，代價則是裝填遲緩，無力封住被轟塌的缺口。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 至元十二年（1275）攻常州的兩方，是已在長江中游站住腳跟的元朝，與退守江南、倚運河佈防的南宋。元的方面，伯顏以中書右丞相、行中書省總統江南大軍，兵馬由蒙古騎兵、北方漢軍、漢人降軍與色目攻城工程隊組成，前鋒設於鎮江、池州一線，糧秣自淮東沿運河船運而下，軍令由伯顏與阿剌罕等宗王分掌，攻城所用的配重投石機由回回砲手操作。南宋方面，臨安朝廷以謝太后與宋恭帝居中樞密院調度，兩淮、江南各路以守臣、鎮戍與募兵自守，常州、平江、鎮江、揚州、泰州沿運河構成一條縱深防線；宋廷一面遣使議和拖延，一面令沿線城池死守，援兵則以勤王名義自各州郡向臨安、鎮江集結。1274年賈似道被貶出京、1275年死於赴漳州途中，朝中主戰與主降之爭加劇，樞密與各鎮各自為守，常州遂成孤立在最前線的堡壘。
countriesEn: The two sides in the siege of Changzhou in 1275 were the Yuan dynasty, which had already taken its stand in the middle Yangtze, and the Southern Song, which held the Jiangnan heartland and had organised its defence along the Grand Canal. On the Yuan side, Bayan (伯顏) served as right chancellor and head of the Jiangnan campaign administration, and his army combined Mongol cavalry, northern Chinese levies, surrendered Han troops and engineers from the western regions. The forward echelon was planted at Zhenjiang and Chizhou, grain and munitions came down the canal by barge from the eastern Huai, and orders were shared by Bayan with such princes as Aral Khan (阿剌罕). The siege engines were worked by Huihui artillery crews operating counterweight trebuchets, the so-called hui hui pao. On the Song side, the Lin'an court under Empress Dowager Xie (謝太后) and the child emperor directed the war through the Privy Council, while along the two Huai rivers, the Jiangnan circuits and the canal, cities were held by local prefects, military commissioners and recruited troops, forming a single line of depth from Changzhou through Pingjiang, Zhenjiang, Yangzhou and Taizhou. Envoys were sent back and forth to negotiate, but the Song also ordered the frontier cities to hold to the last, and troops mustered under the name of勤王 service were converging on Lin'an and Zhenjiang from every circuit. The removal of Jia Sidao in 1274 and his death on the road to Zhangzhou in 1275 sharpened the quarrel between the war party and the peace party at court, and with command fragmenting into city by city defence, Changzhou was left as an isolated redoubt at the very front of the line.
people: 元軍方面，伯顏是全役的統帥：他以行中書省總統江南大軍，順長江東下後於十月抵達鎮江，隨即以阿剌罕為前鋒主將進逼常州，自己坐鎮鎮江督戰，攻城之得失皆由他裁定。董文炳時任元軍漢人將領，統兵在先，屢次登城督戰，攻城戰中中炮陣亡，是此役元軍最重的損失之一；張弘範與張柔一系漢將亦隨伯顏沿江東下，參與兩淮線上的攻取，後來張弘範更以水軍統帥之身出現在宋元最後一場海戰。南宋方面，常州守臣不肯降元，其名字在宋元兩史中多已失載，只留下「城破之日將士死戰至最後」的記載；平江方向的援軍因蘇州城自身不保而無法到位。同一條防線上的李庭芝、楊亮、劉子山，後來分別在揚州、泰州殉國。文天祥於其時奉詔起兵赴援，兵敗後被元軍扣押，卻在拘押期間為南宋朝廷傳遞議和書信，後得脫逃，隨宋室輾轉於福州、泉州一線，最終為元軍所擒；他日後所記的常州，正是這場城破之後江南士氣崩解的第一個節點。
peopleEn: On the Yuan side, Bayan was the theatre commander. He led the Jiangnan army down the Yangtze, reached Zhenjiang in the tenth month, and put Aral Khan in charge of the assault while he himself remained at Zhenjiang to direct operations, every success and failure being decided by him. Dong Wenbing (董文炳), the Han Chinese general, took the van, went up to the walls repeatedly and was killed by a shot during the assault; his death was among the gravest losses the Yuan suffered here. Zhang Hongfan (張弘範) and the rest of the Zhang clan of Han generals moved east with Bayan, took part in the fighting along the Huai and the lower Yangtze, and Zhang Hongfan later appeared as the commander of the Yuan fleet in the last sea battle of the Song. On the Song side, the defenders of Changzhou refused terms, and their names have largely been lost in the histories of both dynasties: what survives is the record that the garrison fought to the last man when the wall fell. Relief from Pingjiang never came, because Suzhou was itself in danger. Li Tingzhi, Yang Liang and Liu Zishan, on the same line of defence, were later killed at Yangzhou and Taizhou. Wen Tianxiang (文天祥) was at that moment mustering troops for the cause; after his defeat he was held by the Yuan, and it was from captivity that he carried the Song court's letters for peace. He escaped, moved with the house of Song towards Fuzhou and Quanzhou, and was finally retaken. His later writings of Changzhou preserve the sense that the fall of the city was the first moment when the military spirit of Jiangnan broke.
kits: 常州城頭那批弩手手裡的弩，是這場戰役最靠得住的裝備。卡面所繪的十字弩是十二世紀末在歐洲出現的機械化弩：曲柄拉弦、機括蓄力、扣扳機發矢，一個人即可完成，箭短而重、穿透力強，卻因此在野戰中難以抵擋騎兵衝鋒，裝填的節奏也完全由雙手決定。中國弩走的是另一條路：宋軍的擘張弩、蹶張弩、穿甲弩與神臂弓成體系地編入「神臂弓營」「弩手營」，張弦要兩三人合力，上弦與瞄定分由不同人手擔任，射程比歐式弩更遠，整個弩系都是為城頭與遠距壓制而設，常州之戰的守軍正是靠這批弩在城垛上壓住元軍的填壕部隊與攻城雲梯。與弩並列的攻城技術來自蒙古的工程兵：回回砲即配重式巨石投石機，據元人所記，石彈重逾百斤，擊中城樓時聲如雷霆；另有撞車、雲梯、穴地與填壕用的木柵、柴束。宋軍這邊也有火藥器械，《武經總要》記載的毒火飛煙可作煙幕，霹靂一類的火藥砲則用於毀壞攻城器械。糧秣與軍械靠運河船隊自北而南轉運，箭矢以竹木為桿、翎羽為尾，壯年男子多被徵發隨軍，弩機與弦的補充最終仍要靠人力背扛入城。
kitsEn: The crossbow was the most dependable equipment in this campaign, and the crossbows in the hands of the men on the parapet of Changzhou were where it mattered. The crossbow on the card is the European type that appeared in the west at the end of the twelfth century: a crank-drawn string held in a lock, released by a trigger, fired by one man, with a short heavy bolt that punched through armour but left the weapon slow to reload and awkward against a charge of horse. Chinese crossbows took a different road. The Southern Song fielded the drawing crossbow, the foot-powered crossbow, the armour-piercing crossbow and the Shenbi crossbow as a system, drawn up in units of crossbowmen and Shenbi archers, with two or three men needed to cock the string and separate hands to aim and loose; their range exceeded that of the western type, and the whole family was built for the parapet and for long-range suppression. The garrison of Changzhou used exactly such weapons to pin the Yuan crews filling the ditch and the siege ladders. Beside them stood the Mongol engineers' artillery, the hui hui pao, a counterweight trebuchet whose stones were reported to weigh more than a hundred jin and which struck the towers with a report like thunder, together with battering rams, ladders, mine tunnels, and hurdles and brushwood for filling the ditch. The Song had gunpowder devices of their own: the toxic smoke mixture recorded in the Wujing Zongyao, and thunder-crash bombs of the thunderbolt type used to destroy the enemy's engines. Food, arms and bolts moved in canal barges, with bamboo and wood shafts and feathered fletchings, and the upkeep of locks and strings finally depended on men carrying loads into the city on their backs.
tactics: 元軍沒有把兵力平均攤在四面城牆上。他們在常州北面與西面築起環城的土木壘牆，壘中設營帳、馬廄與爐場，把填壕的役夫、木料與糧食全部前置，使守軍無法出城反擊；再以回回砲選擇城牆東段與西南角一帶集中轟擊，砲位設在壘牆與土堤之後，擊發一次即轉移，因為宋軍的火箭與夜襲專盯著砲架。壕溝極寬，元軍以木柵、柴束、土袋層層填平，再築木城與土堤直抵牆根，然後雲梯、撞車同時上，兵力集中在同一段城牆，以求一鼓作氣破城。南宋守軍則以弓弩混編分守各段城垛，弩手藏入城樓與女牆的覆庇之下，弓手頂在城垛上速射，長槍兵與步卒在馬道後方結陣，專候城破時封堵缺口；守軍屢次趁夜出城燒毀攻城器械與砲架，令元軍不得不重立砲位、延後進攻，又以弓弩居高攔射填壕與搬運的隊伍。自十月進攻到十一月城破，前後數十日，雙方就這樣反覆拉鋸，直到城牆被轟出缺口，城內外短兵相接，最後以守軍全滅收場。
tacticsEn: The Yuan did not spread their strength evenly along the ramparts. They raised earthen and timber works around the north and west of the city, with quarters, horse lines and firing pits inside them, and brought forward the labour, timber and stores needed to fill the ditch, so that the garrison could not sally out to harass them. Their trebuchets were concentrated against the eastern stretch of wall and the south-west angle, and were set behind the works and the earth ramp; after each shot the engine was moved, because the Song watchmen and their fire arrows hunted the frames. The moat was very broad and was filled layer by layer with hurdles, brushwood and sacks of earth, after which timber towers and earth ramps were driven up to the foot of the wall. Ladders and rams then went up together, the assault massed on a single sector so that one push would carry the wall. The Song answered by posting mixed bow and crossbow ranks along every stretch of the parapet, crossbowmen sheltered under the towers and the covered way, archers shooting from the crenellations, and spears and foot soldiers drawn up behind the wall-walk to plug any breach. They sallied by night to burn the engines and the trebuchet frames, forcing the Yuan to reset their artillery and postpone the assault, and they shot down the crews filling the ditch and carrying stores. For some dozens of days the two sides pulled at each other in this way, until the wall was broken, the fighting moved into the streets, and it ended with the destruction of the garrison.
data: 可核對的數字並不多，而且南北兩側的記載常有出入。距離方面，常州至鎮江的水路約三十公里，運河船一日可達；常州至揚州約九十公里，至臨安約一百七十公里，正是這條水道決定了元軍的行軍節奏。時間方面，至元十二年十月伯顏兵抵鎮江並開始攻常州，十一月城破，前後不過數十日，比襄陽、樊城那樣耗去數年的攻城要快得多。兵力方面，伯顏自河南、山東與襄漢一線收兵，總數常被史家寫成「百萬」，落到江南正面的實際投入應是數十萬量級，其中攻常州的阿剌罕所部為數萬之眾；城內守軍與自平江方向趕來試圖解圍的部隊，諸史或稱數萬、或稱不及其半，難以核實。損失方面，攻城屢挫，元軍死傷與器械損耗都很大，董文炳陣亡，宋軍則全城覆沒。武器射程上，《武經總要》記神臂弓可遠至三百步上下，回回砲所發石彈則以百餘斤計，這兩個數字大致標定了常州攻防中遠程火力與城頭火力交錯的距離。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, and the northern and southern accounts often disagree. On distance, the water run from Changzhou to Zhenjiang is about thirty kilometres, a single day's passage for a canal barge; Changzhou lies roughly ninety kilometres from Yangzhou and about one hundred and seventy from Lin'an, and that waterway set the pace of the Yuan march. On time, Bayan's army reached Zhenjiang and began the siege in the tenth month of the twelfth year of the Zhiyuan era, and the city fell in the eleventh, a matter of some dozens of days, a far quicker business than the siege of Xiangyang and Fancheng, which had dragged on for years. On numbers, the Yuan drew troops in from Henan, Shandong and the Xiangyang-Han line, and the histories habitually call the host a million, but the force actually committed in the Jiangnan was of the order of several hundreds of thousands, of which Aral Khan's division at Changzhou numbered several tens of thousands; the garrison and the relieving force that tried to come up from Pingjiang are given variously as several tens of thousands or as fewer than half that, and cannot be verified. On losses, the assaults were costly, the Yuan taking heavy casualties and losing much equipment, Dong Wenbing among the dead, while the Song force was wiped out. On range, the Wujing Zongyao gives the Shenbi crossbow something like three hundred paces, and the trebuchet stones are reckoned at over a hundred jin, and those two figures roughly mark the distance at which the long-range artillery of the besiegers and the firing positions of the defenders met over the walls of Changzhou.
cause: 打起來有兩層原因。表層是元軍的戰略安排：伯顏取鄂州、順江東下之後，江南已無可倚之屏障，剩下的唯一阻礙是運河沿線的城池；要讓大軍與糧船直抵臨安，必須先拔掉常州、平江這些卡在水道上的城，於是常州成了首當其衝的一處。深層則是南宋的處境：恭帝即位後朝政全歸謝太后，樞密院與各鎮自募兵卒，錢糧調度困難，賈似道已死而主和之議未絕，朝廷屢遣使議和，伯顏也致書勸降，雙方在至元十二年秋天仍在談判，常州守臣卻拒絕開城，談判就此破裂，元軍隨即用兵。常州守軍還有一層實際考量：常州失守，平江、鎮江、揚州、泰州便無從守禦，糧道與援軍都會被切斷，留在城內死守是唯一能拖住元軍的辦法。於是守城與攻城兩邊都沒有退路，一場原本可以用歸降或用談判解決的城池，最終只能用血來結算。
causeEn: There were two levels of reason. On the surface lay the Yuan plan of campaign: after taking Ezhou and coming down the Yangtze, Jiangnan had no natural barrier left, and the only obstacles were the cities on the canal. To bring the army and the grain barges to Lin'an, Changzhou, Pingjiang and the rest had to be removed, and Changzhou was simply the first of them. Below that lay the Song's situation. Under the child emperor the government was in the hands of the dowager empress, the Privy Council and the regional commissioners each raised their own men, money and grain could not be moved freely, Jia Sidao was dead and the party favouring peace had not been silenced. Envoys were still moving between the two courts when Bayan wrote urging surrender in the autumn of the twelfth year of the Zhiyuan era; the garrison of Changzhou refused to open its gates, the negotiations collapsed, and the Yuan turned to their weapons. The defenders had a further practical reason: once Changzhou fell, Pingjiang, Zhenjiang, Yangzhou and Taizhou could not be held, and the road for supplies and for relief would be cut. To remain and fight was the only way to slow the Yuan. Neither side could retreat, and a dispute that could have been settled by surrender or by treaty was finally settled by force of arms.
impact: 常州陷落的意義，遠超一座城池的得失。它把南宋在江南最後一條完整的防線切斷：元軍據此控制運河中段，揚州、泰州先後在十二月至翌年正月失守，李庭芝、楊亮、劉子山等兩淮名將相繼殉國，兩淮兵勢從此再無復振。1276年正月元軍抵達臨安，恭帝奉表出降，宋朝中央政權覆亡；流亡的宋室先後轉入福州、泉州，最終在1279年的崖山被消滅，常州可以說是南宋由守城轉為流亡的起點。技術史上，此役同時留下兩套機械投射武器的對照：中國弩兵以密集的機弩控制城頭，西亞來源的配重投石機則把城牆本身作為攻擊對象，兩者同時出現在一道城牆的兩側，此後數百年中歐兩地在弩與配重砲上的技術互動，都是從這一類的攻城現場開始累積的。對宋人而言，常州則是一個明確的訊號：城牆擋不住配重砲，縱有善射的弩手，也守不住一段被轟塌的城牆。
impactEn: The fall of Changzhou meant far more than the loss of one city. It cut the last continuous line of defence the Song held in Jiangnan: with the Yuan master of the middle canal, Yangzhou and Taizhou were lost between the twelfth month and the following first month, and commanders of the two Huai rivers, Li Tingzhi, Yang Liang and Liu Zishan, died in the fighting, after which the Huai armies never recovered their nerve. In the first month of 1276 the Yuan reached Lin'an, the child emperor surrendered in a formal audience, and the central government of the Song ceased to exist; the house of Song went on to Fuzhou and then Quanzhou, and was destroyed at Yamen in 1279. Changzhou was the point at which the Song turned from siege to exile. For the history of arms the campaign is a rare side by side view of two mechanical missile systems: the Chinese crossbow companies held the parapet, and the counterweight trebuchet from the west treated the wall itself as the target. Both were present on opposite sides of the same wall, and the later exchange of crossbow and counterweight artillery between China and Europe drew on exactly such siege fronts. To the Song, the message of Changzhou was plain: a wall could not withstand a counterweight engine, and no matter how well the crossbowmen shot, they could not hold a parapet that had been broken open.
result: 至元十二年十一月，常州城破。守軍沒有降，自將領到步卒在城牆缺口與街巷中抵抗到底，據宋元文獻所記，將士全數戰死於城頭與街市，城內再無成建制的宋軍。城破之後，元軍接管了常州城防，收繳了守軍留下的弩、弓、箭與軍械，把常州變成向平江、鎮江進軍的前進基地；攻城中的元將董文炳陣亡，朝廷為之舉哀，其部由副將收攏，繼續向前進取。消息傳到江南，沿線州縣震動，兩淮守軍的士氣在數日之內崩解，平江在十二月中被攻陷，鎮江、揚州相繼淪陷，臨安的城門在翌年正月打開。常州之戰因此成了南宋的終點線：城破之日，南宋在江南的抵抗從守城改為流亡，從正規戰改為游擊與抗爭，而它的軍隊、武器與經驗，最後在崖山前的海面上全部收束完畢。
resultEn: Changzhou fell in the eleventh month of the twelfth year of the Zhiyuan era. The garrison did not surrender; officers and men fought on the breach and in the streets until the last, and the Song and Yuan records agree that the defenders were killed to a man on the walls and in the streets, with no formed body of Song soldiers left inside the city. The Yuan took over the city, seized the crossbows, bows, bolts and stores the garrison had left behind, and made Changzhou a forward base for the advance on Pingjiang and Zhenjiang. The Yuan general Dong Wenbing, killed in the assault, was mourned at court, and his command was gathered up by the officers who had served under him and pushed on. The news broke the morale of the Song along the line: Pingjiang fell in the middle of the following month, Zhenjiang and Yangzhou went with it, and the gates of Lin'an opened in the first month of the following year. Changzhou was therefore the end of the Song's line. The day the wall fell, resistance in Jiangnan changed from the defence of cities to exile, and from regular war to skirmishing and insurrection, and the troops, weapons and experience of the Song were finally gathered up in one place before the sea battle at Yamen.
